text.p: Vickers Ballas has upgraded steel manufacturer NatSteel to "neutral" from "underperform", the brokerage said in a statement received by Reuters on Monday.
The statement said the company's industrial and electronics divisions were expected to lead the group's earnings growth.
A Vickers analyst told Reuters NatSteel shares were currently fairly valued as they were trading at the bottom of their historic price earnings ratio band of 18 times to 30 times.
The shares were also supported by a net asset value of Singapore $2.09, he said.

"While the steel devision is going through a gestation phase, (industrial and electronics) are leaders in their respective industries and will continue to make a significant contribution to the group earnings," Vickers said.
NatSteel shares were last four cents down at S$2.48.
